justification: A shows a large radiating pinwheel/spiral disc framed by bands of running-wave ornament and small silhouetted quadrupeds in profile, while B shows a fragmentary relief with human figures in profile and an animal-like mass, with no framing bands or geometric centrepiece. The only overlap is generic — profile creatures and some curving lines — with wholly different organising schemes (centred geometric emblem with ornamental borders versus a figural narrative relief).
